key_insight: AI-assisted reconstruction turns legacy planning claims about cooperation and competition into explicit, formally checked guarantees while exposing missing assumptions and counterexamples.
engineering_relevance: The verified negotiation procedure guarantees termination, participant approval, joint-cost non-worsening and local optimality against permitted approved moves.
method: Specify outsider opportunities and efficiency conditions for Nash-to-core implications.
Formalize negotiation in Lean and characterize the financing gap in a monotone resource model.
Retain counterexamples and compare the verified procedure with heuristic and randomized controls.
evidence_signal: Reproducible computations cover 44 source-based instances and 96 starting cases across four additional synthetic network families, with acceptance-matched heuristic and randomized pairwise-search controls.
watch_item: The guarantees depend on explicit assumptions and permitted moves; monotonicity alone provides no uniform price-of-anarchy bound.
paper_title: Formalizing Cooperation and Competition: An AI-Assisted Mathematical Addendum to a 2018 Planning Thesis
